title: alectra sessiliflora
intro: Alectra sessiliflora, commonly known as the 'African Witchweed' or 'Alectra', is a parasitic flowering plant native to tropical Africa. This plant is known to possess various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Alectra sessiliflora include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its medicinal uses. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its bioactive properties.
